text: The Pediatric Registry for Stroke as a Multidisciplinary Approach to healthcare research (PRiSMA) study aims to systematically collect longitudinal prospective observational data across the acute and long-term phases to optimise diagnosis, personalised acute therapy, neurorehabilitation, and prevention of recurrent stroke. The data will inform development of further hypothesis-driven studies of childhood stroke in national and international networks.
source_label: Protocol for the establishment of the Pediatric Registry for Stroke as a Multidisciplinary Approach to healthcare research (PRiSMA) study
